name: Houkago Dorei-tachi
source:
Main character is a physical education teacher of high school. He is caught red-handed while peeping at girls changing room, and bad rumors start to spread all over the school. He sets up a humiliation trap for the two girls responsible of his downfall.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名高中体育老师。他在偷看女生更衣室时被当场抓获，坏消息开始在学校传开。他为导致他垮台的两个女孩设置了羞辱陷阱。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
